comment: Love the new budget view. Setting category limits took me two minutes and the weekly summary email is exactly what I wanted.
The app logged me out three times today and I lost a half-finished expense entry. Really frustrating when I'm trying to log receipts on the go.
Great app overall. Would love dark mode though, my eyes hurt using it at night.
I was charged twice for the annual plan. Support has not answered my email in 5 days. I want a refund and I am considering cancelling.
Bank sync is flawless and the spending charts make it obvious where my money goes. Worth every cent.
Does what it says, but the CSV export is missing the category column, which makes my tax prep annoying.
Sync with my credit union fails every other day with a vague error message. Reconnecting fixes it for a few hours.
Shared budgets with my partner are brilliant. Notifications are a bit too frequent, would like to tune them.
Subscription renewed after I cancelled. This feels like a trick. Please fix your billing and refund me.
Customer support replied within an hour and solved my currency issue. Fantastic service!
The app is slow to open on my older phone, takes about 8 seconds. Features are good though.
Recurring bills reminder saved me from a late fee. Would be perfect if I could attach a photo of the invoice.
